text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d l-o-g-i-n a-t-t-e-m-p-t-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s b-y u-s-i-n-g c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l s-t-r-i-n-g s e-r-v-i-c-e s, l-e-f-t l-o-g f-i-l-e s t-h-a-t r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d i-n-t-e-r-c-e-p-t-e-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n t-o-k-e-n s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e d-u-e d-i-l-i-g-e-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k o-n i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e s.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-p-l-o-i-t-e-d a-n o-l-d a-p-i e-n-d-p-o-i-n-t t-o g-r-a-b g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e d-a-t-a, l-e-f-t a r-r-a-w q-u-e-r-y l-o-g s-h-o-w-i-n-g b-u-l-k e-x-t-r-a-c-t-i-o-n s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d v-u-l-n-e-r-a-b-i-l-i-t-y r-e-p-o-r-t i-n t-h-e c-l-o-u-d p-a-n-e-l.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-h-a-n-g-e-d o-w-n-e-r s-h-i-p o-f a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s b-y b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-w-o f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n v-i-a s-m-s i-n-t-e-r-c-e-p-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t a c-h-a-n-g-e d-e-t-a-i-l h-i-s-t-o-r-y s-h-o-w-i-n-g n-e-w e-m-a-i-l a-l-t-e-r-a-t-i-o-n s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p f-o-r h-i-g-h v-a-l-u-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d s-t-o-l-e-n b-a-l-a-n-c-e s i-n-t-o c-a-s-h a-n-d g-o-o-d-s b-y p-l-a-c-i-n-g o-r-d-e-r-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h a f-a-k-e s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g a-p-p, l-e-f-t a p-a-y-m-e-n-t l-e-d-g-e r-e-c-o-r-d i-n-g m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g a-l-e-r-t f-o-r u-n-u-s-u-a-l p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-a-k-e-d n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y b-y a-u-t-o-m-a-t-i-n-g b-r-o-w-s-i-n-g s-e-s-s-i-o-n s w-i-t-h s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d u-s-e-r a-g-e-n-t s, l-e-f-t a n-a-v-i-g-a-t-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-y l-o-o-k-i-n-g l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s r-e-v-i-e-w t-h-a-t c-a-n-c-e-l-s f-l-a-g-g-e-d a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s.
